start.obj: Find Baldino's workshop on the Esmer street

lines: n_hero: A tag on the lever: "TEST PAIR. Won't talk. -B"
after 3s lines: n_hero: The hanging one can't see this one. The flying machine's nose is in the way.
n_baldino: They talk by sight. Two old friends across a street: put a cart between them and they sulk.
crank lines: n_hero: Baldino's old hoist. Older than Arthur, and it still turns sweetly.
tap lines: n_baldino: Couplers. Lovely until they're thirsty. That's what the drip is for.
success lines (before intro): n_baldino: The drip, Twinsen. The tap.
talk 1 lines: n_baldino: Twinsen! At last! Mind the... ah. Never mind, I have another one.
n_hero: Baldino, Vesk says the project brings heat and light. What is it really doing?
n_baldino: Look at the globe. Our planet sits inside a shell, like a nut. Beneath the shell sleeps the being Sendell watches over.
n_baldino: Vesk is drilling through the shell. He believes the being is waking and nothing can stop it, so he's saving whoever he can. The rest... he isn't.
n_hero: Then we stop the drill.
n_baldino: No, no, no! Stop it halfway and the shell cracks on its own. We have to go down there and reverse it. But first we need to get past the platform's shield.
n_baldino: That's why I built an override key. Well, almost. Two parts are missing: the cog from the top of the old mill, and the code cylinder in the project depot's locker.
n_baldino: The shield draws power from the three mills. Brake them with your ball, and the shield will be weak enough for the key to open it.
n_baldino: One more thing. Nobody on Citadel Island knows any of this. Zoé is waiting at the lighthouse. When the key is ready, she'll broadcast a warning to the whole island.
talk 2 lines: n_baldino: A cog from the old mill, a code cylinder from the depot. And don't forget the brakes!
n_baldino: The hoist is older than Arthur. It lifts everything I build. Mostly back down again.
